title: Enforce source quotas, retries and resumable scheduling
objective: Thousands of checks respect publisher limits and survive retries without unbounded queues or double-spending the last reservation.
outcome: Budget exhaustion is an explicit incomplete run. Concurrent workers cannot both spend the last reservation. Cancellation releases only unused reservations. Transient 429/5xx/timeout retries are bounded with Retry-After. Credential/parser/scientific ambiguity is not blindly retried. Resumed runs emit a denominator report and cannot overwrite a newer capture.

commits.subject: Reserve source request budgets
commits.instructions: Add per-host concurrency and daily request/byte reservations with UTC periods and a source-specific override table. Reuse the durable lease store.
commits.verification: Concurrent workers cannot both spend the last reservation; cancellation releases only unused reservations.

commits.subject: Classify and schedule retries
commits.instructions: Retry documented transient timeouts/429/5xx with bounded attempts and Retry-After. Route credential, parser and scientific ambiguity to specific queues without blind retries.
commits.verification: Fixture traces show the exact maximum request count and delay schedule for each outcome.

commits.subject: Reconcile resumed source runs
commits.instructions: Track completed, waiting, failed and skipped records with source-generation pins. Emit a denominator report after a restart or partial run.
commits.verification: Repeated completion/retry messages remain idempotent; a newer source capture cannot be overwritten by an older resumed job.
